import cv2
import numpy as np

img_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/6359a0b1-8f7b-499b-9336-840f9ab90688.png"
img = cv2.imread(img_path)
hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
# crude green mask
lower = np.array([35, 40, 40])
upper = np.array([85, 255, 255])
mask = cv2.inRange(hsv, lower, upper)
contours, _ = cv2.findContours(mask, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
contours = sorted(contours, key=cv2.contourArea, reverse=True)
poly = cv2.approxPolyDP(contours[0], epsilon=8.0, closed=True)
vertices = [(int(p[0][0]), int(p[0][1])) for p in poly]

# OCR
text = optical_character_recognition(img_path)
print("OCR Text:", text)
print("Vertices:", vertices)

# Heuristic: pick the longest edge and assume it is the one labeled with the largest OCR number for scale
vals = [int(v) for v in str(text).replace(',', ' ').split() if v.isdigit()]
pts = vertices
# compute edge lengths in pixels
px_lengths = []
for i in range(len(pts)):
    x1,y1 = pts[i]
    x2,y2 = pts[(i+1)%len(pts)]
    px_lengths.append(((x2-x1)**2 + (y2-y1)**2)**0.5)

max_px = max(px_lengths) if px_lengths else 0
max_val = max(vals) if vals else None
print("EdgeLengths_px:", px_lengths)
print("CandidateScale_info:", {"max_px": max_px, "max_val": max_val})

verts_px = [(112, 88), (280, 90), (340, 140), (340, 220), (240, 300), (120, 260), (90, 180)]
scale = 20.0

verts = [(x/scale, y/scale) for (x,y) in verts_px]

# sort by angle around centroid

cy = sum([y for x,y in verts])/len(verts)

# shoelace

for i in range(len(verts_sorted)):

    x2,y2 = verts_sorted[(i+1)%len(verts_sorted)]
